blocks.text: SALT LAKE CITY — Jamal Murray scored 36 points to rally the Denver Nuggets to a 120-107 victory over the Utah Jazz in NBA Cup group play on Friday night. Nikola Jokic tallied 17 points, 15 assists, and nine rebounds for the Nuggets. Christian Braun added 20 points and eight rebounds. Keyonte George scored 25 points and Darryn Peterson added 20 to lead the Jazz. Svi Mykhailiuk added 18 points off the bench.
